title: Dataset
description: One experiment: conditions plus time-resolved amounts. Electrochemical runs give amounts in mM of nitrogen (conditions.c0_mM_N); other domains, such as solid-state synthesis, declare conditions.basis and give initial amounts in conditions.c0 on that basis. Used for real (Source Data, digitized) and simulated data alike.

figure.description: Figure or table the numbers come from.

file.description: Source file name (not committed to the repo if large or licensed).

extraction.description: Script or tool used, and any manual steps.

potential_V_vs_RHE.description: Null when not reported or not converted to RHE; explain in notes.

c0_mM_N.description: Initial concentrations keyed by species id, in mM of nitrogen. Unlisted species start at 0.

basis.description: Unit of every amount when it is not mM-N, e.g. 'mol per mol Ti' (formula units per mole of the conserved element). Electrochemical datasets omit it.

c0.description: Initial amounts keyed by species id, on conditions.basis. Unlisted species start at 0.

precursors.description: Precursor mixture as prepared, e.g. '5:2 TiO2 (anatase):Li2CO3 molar, pelletized'.

y.description: Concentration in mM-N after normalization. Null for missing points.

reported_unit.description: Unit as reported in the source, e.g. 'ug mL-1 as N'.

conversion.description: How reported values were converted to mM-N.

n_closure.description: Fraction of initial N accounted for by the measured species at each time.

reported_n_loss.description: Loss of nitrogen mass balance as plotted or tabulated by the source authors (mM-N), independent of our own closure calculation. Not a species and never a fitting target.

n_basis_note.description: How the N basis of each species (per molecule vs per N atom) was established.

basis_note.description: How amounts on conditions.basis were derived from the reported quantities (e.g. weight fractions to mol per mol Ti), and what that basis cannot show.
